lines: If you can't answer that, you're not alone. But you *are* in trouble.
Not in one big mistake. In a hundred *small* ones.
Ten here. Twenty there. A little *more* on the weekend.
And suddenly the month is gone and you don't know *where.*
Not because they're obsessed. Because they're in *control.*
So today, open your bank app. Look at last *month.*
Set a limit for what you *love.*
You can't fix a leak you refuse to *look* at.
It's to spend on purpose, not on *autopilot.*
Find it. Plug it. Send that money to *work.*
end: Save this and check your account today.
